cs.t: I use HN all the time with the web site on an iPad and find nothing wrong with it.  It works fine on Amazon Fire Tablets too but my Samsung A7 struggles to boot,  never mind do anything at all. Granted people are amazed that somebody who writes long articulate comments makes such terrible spelling errors and typos but that tends to happen if you write into a little text box on a touchscreen.  A better spell checker and UI for posting might benefit me,  but it might need an A.I. highly tailored to me and what I write.
cs.th: Ask HN: Can you recommend full featured HN iOS app?
